title: Bar Drop Banana Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Banana Ice by Drop delivers a smooth, tropical experience with a refreshing arctic finish. This blend captures the creamy, sweet notes of ripe bananas, offering a rich and velvety texture on the inhale. The sweetness is perfectly counterbalanced by a brisk wave of ice menthol on the exhale, ensuring the flavour remains crisp and never too heavy. It is a classic profile refined for vapers who love a cool, creamy fruit vape. Distinct from typical bar salts, this e-liquid features a 40% VG / 60% PG ratio. This composition prioritises flavour clarity, ensuring the creamy banana notes are vivid and distinct. Ideally suited for low-wattage MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vape kits, the nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth draw and quick satisfaction, available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Manufactured by UK brand Drop, Bar Drop Salts range of nic salt e-liquids focus on fruity flavours that are endlessly popular as well as a few unique profiles you won’t find anywhere else.
